title: Stored x-only leaf birthday search on secp256k1 at 124.999314927438: six leaves per batched inverse held as Fourier components, a two-fraction class label summed from them, metered rare-carry branches and k-record block messages

claims.statement: For uniform production secp256k1 Q=[x]P, the classical cold stored-leaf birthday search of proof.md recovers x with probability at least 0.390000001 over the challenge and fresh algorithm coins, with no heuristic: the Chen-Stein method on cross-node leaf pairs bounds P(no collision), and drops, caps, wrong class indices, label errors and the enumerated carry sites of the kernels (section 3.4) are charged failure rows, as are the caps of two meters, while RNDR, the ideal coin source, adds none (section 6, in success.md). On every run its total work is at most 2^124.999314927438 target-group-operation equivalents (1000 AArch64 instructions per unit). Each pair of generator points X, Y gives six leaves, the x-coordinates of phi^t(X) + Y and phi^t(X) - Y for t = 0, 1, 2, from one batched inverse of y_Y^2 - y_X^2; they are never formed: with a = x_X, b = x_Y, E = b^4 + 2a^3 b, F = a^4 + 2ab^3, G = 3a^2 b^2 and w = u^2 or v^2 (u = 1/(y_Y + y_X), v = 1/(y_Y - y_X)), each sign's leaves are the discrete Fourier transform (Ew - b) + beta^t (Fw - a) + beta^(2t) Gw, and the backward pass stores the six components Ew, Fw, Gw (1206.5 instructions per pair, section 3.1). A class's label is the top 100 bits of the fractions v*/p and (beta v* mod p)/p, v* = min(x, beta x, beta^2 x); as fractions mod 1 add and beta rotates a component's three fractions, each leaf's fractions are sums of its components' (with correction words -T(b), -T(beta b), -T(a), -T(beta a) for the linear terms), within [-73, 73], [-73, 206] and [-212, 146] at 128 bits, and KEY's index j on their top words picks the pair (j, j + 1) (section 3.3). A leaf in the window set W, where j may be wrong (rate below 2^-58.47 per leaf), or in the label-error set D' near a block boundary (below 2^-17.38) is a charged missed-collision row; no leaf is dropped. Records give the sign, not t, so the resolver tries each record's three leaf types. A lattice count from secp256k1's Frobenius bounds a box of label values at 1 + 2^-18 times its share, so classes sharing the 184 matched bits give false candidates charged to the caps. Machine (section 2.1): 2^72 nodes, each with one processor (base AArch64 with FEAT_RNG and FEAT_LSE) and a memory below 2^64 bytes; links keep no flags, rings or counters. Each record goes into its destination's record block of k = 128 slots in the sender's port; a full block is one message, charged its delivery as executed route.s dlvk (4k + 2 = 514) and its port's in-flight count (2), and kept or dropped whole, so the records kept, their order and the final cursors are those of sending each record alone (section 4). Hop 1, hop 2 and grouping are charged 8 + 523/128, 8.25 + 523/128 and 14.546875 per record. The rare carries and borrows of the field macros are taken by a branch over a fixup that completes the chain, so every result is bit-identical to an inline chain; a node starts a batch only while its fixups are at most 2^45 - 37 q2, so the ledger charges 4*2^45 per node and Markov's inequality charges the cap. certificate.py gives at most 307.7797 instructions per leaf and the claim 124.999314927438. Peak memory at most 2^135.9989 bytes; preprocessing at most 2^110.1509 units, included; no advice; certificate.py checks that the work, memory and preprocessing figures are the least 12-decimal (work) or 4-decimal values at or above their exact values, and that 0.390000001 is below the success bound. The bound is for the machine of section 2.1. Lineage: our e59be87d (the base: k-record messages) and its ancestors 10c5d938, bbe1cd85, a3ca3235, 5b6cd013, 502d7155, eb0aea59, f9d5a673 and b3716a20; 8f733826, c8a6819e, 02feb284, 4595bad7, fce6e7ef, 3828873f, 6ef3e7b3, d637fb0a, 9798f5f4, d9e3dbf4, 472226d8, 4fdb8a9c, e1ecd7cc, 80e9e8af, 1efcef88, 892a3df8, b00400fa, 1fbd26e8, 807e4bf5, a9297fb0, 7e8d13c7 and ecc3ec1b, each credited in section 9; new here are the leaves held as their Fourier components, the label summed from the components' fractions with its error ranges, W and D', and the resolver's type trial; no prior acceptance or score is a premise. This is an analytic bound, not a practical break.

experiments.purpose: Run the leaf kernels on production points against exact arithmetic (components, the Fourier identity, records against a bit-exact model of keys, indices and labels outside W and D') and the class-rule and class-label tests; the emit, both hops (each message delivered by executing dlv or dlvk) and the grouping on a 4 x 4 machine (machine.py); the sites and fixups of section 3.4 (sites.py); every kernel count against certificate.py, which it runs. Budget-limited parts run stated minimums. Not a production-scale attack.
